tools.name: shoprenter_list_products
tools.description: List products of the shop: sku, prices, stock flags, status and dates. Filter by sku or innerId (the shop's own number). Shoprenter API: GET /api/products.

tools.name: shoprenter_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its id, with all its fields. Shoprenter API: GET /api/products/{id}.

tools.name: shoprenter_list_categories
tools.description: List the product categories of the shop, with their status and parent. Shoprenter API: GET /api/categories.

tools.name: shoprenter_get_category
tools.description: Get one category by its id. Shoprenter API: GET /api/categories/{id}.

tools.name: shoprenter_list_manufacturers
tools.description: List the manufacturers (brands) of the shop. Shoprenter API: GET /api/manufacturers.

tools.name: shoprenter_list_stock_statuses
tools.description: List the stock status labels the shop shows for products (in stock, out of stock, and so on). Shoprenter API: GET /api/stockStatuses.

tools.name: shoprenter_list_orders
tools.description: List orders of the shop, newest first by default. Filter by email, order status id, creation or update window (datetime 1990-01-01T00:00:00). Shoprenter API: GET /api/orders.

tools.name: shoprenter_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by its id, with totals, addresses, status and links to its items. Shoprenter API: GET /api/orders/{id}.

tools.name: shoprenter_list_order_statuses
tools.description: List the order statuses the shop uses (for example new, paid, shipped). Shoprenter API: GET /api/orderStatuses.

tools.name: shoprenter_list_customers
tools.description: List customers of the shop. Filter by email, innerId, or a creation or update window (datetime 1990-01-01T00:00:00). Shoprenter API: GET /api/customers.

tools.name: shoprenter_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by its id, with group, status and addresses. Shoprenter API: GET /api/customers/{id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shoprenter_list_orders, shoprenter_list_customers · Public sink: shoprenter_list_orders, shoprenter_list_customers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shoprenter_list_orders, shoprenter_list_customers · Public sink: shoprenter_list_orders, shoprenter_list_customers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
